primaryArtifact.contents:
AUTHORITATIVE ADMINISTRATIVE REORGANISATION EXTRACT: TELANGANA GAZETTE 2016
==============================================================================
Source Authority: Government of Telangana, Revenue (DA-CMRF) Department
Document: Telangana Gazette Extraordinary, Part I, Notification under
          Telangana District Formation Act, 1974 (Act No. 7 of 1974)
Statutory Orders:
  - G.O.Ms.No. 222, Revenue (DA-CMRF) Dept, dated 11.10.2016 (Formation of Mancherial District)
  - G.O.Ms.No. 224, Revenue (DA-CMRF) Dept, dated 11.10.2016 (Formation of Kumuram Bheem District)
Source URL: https://goir.telangana.gov.in / https://mancherial.telangana.gov.in
Retrieval Date: 2026-09-22
Effective Date: 2016-10-11

PARTICULARS OF G.O.Ms.No. 222 (MANCHERIAL DISTRICT):
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. Erstwhile District: Adilabad (District Code 533)
2. Newly Formed District: Mancherial District (LGD District Code 684)
3. Revenue Divisions: Mancherial and Bellampalli
4. Mandals Formed / Reorganised (18 total):
   Chennur, Luxettipet, Mancherial, Dandepally, Bellampalli, Kotapalli,
   Hajipur, Jaipur, Mandamarri, Kasipet, Tandur, Bhimini, Nennal,
   Vemanpalli, Jannaram, Bheemaram, Kannepally, Naspur.

5. Lineage Particulars for Hajipur Mandal:
   - Formation Type: Carved out as a new Mandal on 11.10.2016.
   - Predecessor Entity: Mancherial Mandal (constituent revenue villages
     bifurcated to form the newly created Hajipur Tahsil/Mandal office).
   - Predecessor Canonical ID: TS-MDL-5321 (Mancherial)
   - Successor Canonical ID: TS-MDL-5329 (Hajipur)
   - Transition Type: 'split'
   - Effective Date: 2016-10-11
   - Statutory Citation: G.O.Ms.No. 222, Revenue (DA-CMRF) Dept, dated 11.10.2016
   - Electoral Delimitation Impact: Article 170 boundary freeze preserves 2008
     Assembly Constituency boundaries. Constituent villages remain part of
     AC 4 (Mancherial).

PARTICULARS OF G.O.Ms.No. 224 (KUMURAM BHEEM ASIFABAD DISTRICT):
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. Erstwhile District: Adilabad (District Code 533)
2. Newly Formed District: Kumuram Bheem Asifabad District (LGD District Code 699)
3. Revenue Divisions: Asifabad and Kagaznagar
4. Mandals Formed / Reorganised (15 total):
   Sirpur (T), Kagaznagar, Dahegaon, Tiryani, Asifabad, Bejjur, Chintalamanepalli,
   Jainoor, Kerameri, Koutala, Lingapur, Penchikalpet, Rebbena, Sirpur (U), Wankidi.
==============================================================================

section8_proposedRemediation.rationale: Evidence record e0160000-0000-0000-0000-000000002016 covers G.O.Ms. Nos. 214-245 Rev (2016-10-11), which is the complete batch of statutory reorganisation orders. G.O.Ms.No. 222 is order number 222 within this range. The artifact_name "goms_2016_reorganisation_orders.pdf" and verification_notes "Statutory reorganisation orders G.O.Ms. Nos. 214-245 Rev (2016-10-11) establishing 589 baseline mandals" confirm that this evidence record is the authoritative source for the Mancherial-Hajipur bifurcation legal event. Additionally, the repository contains the preserved text extract data/evidence/w015_b2/telangana_gazette_2016_goms_222_mancherial.txt which explicitly documents the G.O.Ms.No. 222 particulars including the Hajipur split details. The proposed verified_by "CTO / Statutory Gazette Reconciliation" matches the evidence record's own verified_by field, and also matches the verified_by used for all 589 historical baseline provenance records referencing this same evidence.
section8_proposedRemediation.statusJustification: status = OFFICIAL is semantically justified because the gazette lineage canonical reconciliation is directly supported by the statutory gazette reorganisation orders — the highest authority for administrative boundary modifications in Telangana. The evidence record e0160000-0000-0000-0000-000000002016 establishes the legal basis for the complete 2016 reorganisation, within which G.O.Ms.No. 222 specifically ordered the formation of Mancherial District and thereby the bifurcation of mandals including the creation of Hajipur from Mancherial.
section8_proposedRemediation.w012MechanismDescription: Same Classification-B lifecycle mechanism used in GOV-10: scoped PATCH on exact 1 provenance UUID via PostgREST Service-Role, updating verification_evidence_id and verified_by while leaving all Classification-A immutable fields (id, dataset_version_id, source_record_id, parent_provenance_id, transformation_type, transform_version, operator, created_at) and metadata dictionary untouched. Trigger trg_check_provenance_status_transition will evaluate (OLD.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'OFFICIAL') to FALSE since both are OFFICIAL, cleanly permitting the update.
